room_rent.note: Room limit or category is set in the Policy Schedule; a higher room means proportionate deduction (not applied to ICU).

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay on every claim for anyone who first joins at age 61 or above, even when porting in. Value Plan adds 30% outside its hospital network; Geo Plan adds 20% for treatment in Zone A cities.

sub_limits.note: Procedure sub-limits exist (e.g. robotic surgery capped by SI band). VERIFY full list

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl 18); no maternity benefit found. VERIFY

cumulative_bonus.note: 5X Supercharge Bonus: 50%/yr up to 500%, not reduced on claim

restoration.display: Once/yr, 100% (Restore); unlimited with optional Restore Infinity
restoration.note: Restore refills 100% of sum insured once a year for any illness (same illness only if 45+ days after the last discharge); not usable for the first claim of the year. Optional Restore Infinity makes it unlimited.

ambulance.display: Road: limit per Schedule; Air: optional
ambulance.note: Road ambulance per Schedule; Emergency Air Ambulance is optional (C2). VERIFY road limit

modern_treatments.note: Robotic/modern treatments covered with per-procedure sub-limits by SI band

global_cover.note: Only claims incurred within India are covered.

notable_exclusions.display: Plan-variant co-pays (Value=out-of-network, Geo=Zone A); modern-treatment sub-limits; maternity excluded

optional_riders.display: Restore Infinity (unlimited restore), Emergency Air Ambulance, Consumables Benefit
